data.6575a6ca8778e96ded05a802 Description: A random access storage device (information storage device), based on the magnetic recording principle. Contains various compromising data on TerraGroup.
data.657acb2ac900be5902191ac9 Description: Cadastral registry records containing data on TerraGroup real estate in Tarkov.
data.666073159916667083033cb9 Description: A small diary that had been abandoned by its owner a long time ago. The entries are barely legible due to the rough handwriting.
data.666879d498b97e3a8f09f1ae Description: You can argue endlessly that different factories of the same company provide comparable quality, but at the critical moment everyone chooses the original.... Perhaps TerraGroup had special arrangements with the American factory to supply a newer model of LEDX.
data.667a8ef464eea5fdef0db135 Description: An issue of a gaming magazine that first wrote about one world-famous shooter game.
data.66760b3deb51b08bd40c2b08 Description: A random access storage device (information storage device), based on the magnetic recording principle. Contains stolen user data.
data.66687bc89111279d600b5062 Description: In the old days, the symbol of power in large cities was a luxurious key the size of a hand. In Tarkov, this tradition was revived, but the key itself was made smaller. Some say that this is the reason why it was lost: someone attached the souvenir to a bunch of keys by mistake and took it away from the town day celebration.
data.66c0b39ca1f68fcc1d0c0cc3 Description: The records in this journal reveal side effects after interacting with TerraGroup's drugs... The factory workers likely were unaware of this "research".
data.66c0b90c8398582e4b0c2e27 Description: A RUAF pilot logbook. It's unclear how it ended up in the cockpit of the foreign AS350 helicopter. Either the USECs ran out of their own logbooks, or the BEARs ran out of helicopters.
data.669fac549b0ce3feae01a137 Description: There's no telling what was in the tank container. It looks nasty, and smells even worse. TerraGroup must have used these tanks to store precursors for their research.
data.66a0e523e749756c920d02d0 Description: Hermetic container for storing various chemicals.
data.66a0f0926fee20fa70036da6 Description: A blood sample taken from the body of one of the workers at Chemical Plant No. 16. The bodies are clearly not recent, but the blood has not even dried up. Even the texture is the same as fresh blood.
data.66b22630a6b4e5ec7c02cdb7 Description: A case containing various expensive precision tools.
data.67499a9669a58fceba104a41 Description: A package that the BTR driver was supposed to deliver to Prapor.
data.67499b9b909d2013670a5029 Description: The device is designed to suppress UAV guidance systems. Helps to reliably protect any facility from airborne attacks.
data.67499adbeca8acb2d2061634 Description: A delivery from outside the cordon that Prapor is waiting for. Judging by the weight, it feels like it's half-empty.
data.67499d4deca8acb2d206163b Description: The device is designed to suppress UAV guidance systems. Helps to reliably protect any facility from airborne attacks.
data.67499d0eeca8acb2d2061639 Description: A letter from the BTR driver. Apparently, the information inside could put serious pressure on Skier.
data.67499b3eeca8acb2d2061636 Description: From the sounds of it, the case is filled with something heavy like OFZ shells or other munitions.
data.67499d2c69a58fceba104a43 Description: From the sounds of it, the case is filled with something heavy like OFZ shells or other munitions.
data.675f7acc4076a741a3061566 Description: A stack of documents with data on TerraGroup shipments. Contains reports on completed and planned shipments.
data.675f7b168d28a25ec7007dbb Description: It looks like this journal was used by the entire loading crew to mark all the loads that had already been completed. How could the foreman make any sense of this handwriting?
data.675f80d4fe1b59cf490d3527 Description: The box is sealed, but judging by the sounds inside, it contains the tools Mechanic was looking for.
data.675f7f224076a741a3061568 Description: It's hard to believe this wallet is anything special to Skier. It's just an old, shabby wallet. How has it not disintegrated yet?
data.679b9a1a4e4ed4b3b40ae5c2 Description: Meetings, facilities, and other notes from Knossos senior manager are noted in the diary. If you study them, you can get at least a rough summary of the company's facilities.
data.679b98e429acd1f2f60985a3 Description: A chemical container with a thick, murky liquid inside. Only a lunatic like Sanitar would want to study something like this.
data.679b9aa490622daf9708da73 Name: VPX Flash Storage Module marked Group #3
data.679b9aa490622daf9708da73 Description: The VPX Flash Storage Module (FSM) provides high-performance, high-capacity, solid-state SATA storage with AES-256 bit encryption using an Application Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC). Judging by the marking, it contains data on the focus group experiments and research.
data.679b998180a165f7a40b4c2c Description: A videotape with traces of blood and the words “Slaughter”. The owner of the tape hardly felt sympathy for his victims.
data.683ed6aed885538c4102d8c8 Description: A 24 inch barrel for the AK-50 sniper rifle.
data.683ed6c2e4b1dd7ec4069dc8 Description: A receiver dust cover for the AK-50 sniper rifle.
data.683ed6ccd9a096739b0c9228 Description: An M-LOK handguard with railed gas block for the AK-50 sniper rifle.
data.68666482abad2f29b00aab57 Description: A broken generic phone, nothing out of the ordinary. However it might help to find Mechanic's acquaintance.
data.6866663e022740fabd074ef2 Description:
An unremarkable diary, there are hundreds of those in Tarkov. But don't judge a book by its cover: this particular one contains many dangerous secrets.

The first page has a table of contents:
• Update
• Notes 
• Highlights
• Encrypt
• Agenda 
• Ruminates
• Drafts
data.687502c4660d147e2502a94f Description: A simple disk with a handwritten note that this is the second version, the final one. Finally you can go through the whole game all the way to the end. Gotta write a review later!
data.664fce7a90294949fe2d81cb Description: A folder of photos, charts, bank records, e-mail printouts and surveillance diaries of Arena employees.
data.69bb42b9ce2b96840302b92b Description: The control log of a nuclear power unit records safety parameters, routine inspection results, and various measurements ensuring the safe operation of the Icebreaker’s nuclear reactor.
data.67bde1dc5678472f2a0e6167 Description: A flash drive found at the abandoned high-ranking TerraGroup staff's SUV. Contains something important, though it's unclear what exactly.
data.67bde22566ca1d79a202462f Description: A flight recorder found at the plane that crashed in the Priozersk nature reserve. This device is crucial to figuring out what happened to the plane.
data.67bde548cf0cc29475092192 Description: A flash drive Elektronik used to write the crashed plane crew's conversations. A very valuable piece of intel.
data.689b4d39987b304021088e8d Description: A printout of the transcript from the pilots of the downed aircraft.
data.67bde59edb4b617a6c0d69f8 Description: A mysterious briefcase, apparently containing a certain "Ticket" out of Tarkov.
data.67bdea3ecf0cc29475092196 Description: A device developed by TerraGroup, capable of suppressing digital signals within a 100 meter radius.
data.67bdf097600629c8f20322e5 Description: A pass card that used to grant access to all doors within the system. Used exclusively inside TerraGroup laboratories. No longer operational.
data.67c0324acc87f341720274b6 Description: A device capable of encrypting RFID card data. Features an integrated microcontroller. Commonly used within TerraGroup facilities.
data.68ea992027da8dde060ebfef Description: A note left in the pumping station containing instructions for the maintenance crew.
data.67c033719dacd7c19f0f9f46 Name: Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence
data.67c033719dacd7c19f0f9f46 Description: A small container holding all the documents and audio tapes containing compromising material on TerraGroup. Now they’re guaranteed to reach Mr. Kerman intact.

data.68ea998f01b9ce77ac07081c Description: A printout of the port terminal plan marking the locations of the electrical panels.
data.68dbc04cd700686fbf0d77bd Description: A patch of some special BEAR unit.
data.68da4fa81ddecb1cc0077aee Description: A dogtag belonging to the Bogatyr squad member who has seen hundreds of battles.
data.68da4fe6f0e86677fe06bfe4 Description: Someone fashioned a talisman from a crumpled bullet, either as a keepsake or for luck.
data.68da51d8f0e86677fe06c9b7 Description: On the back of the postcard, someone wrote: "Love you, waiting for you".
data.68fd5aa1c85d51c0130623c9 Description: An old voice recorder that, apparently, was used by Voevoda himself.
